locator: original presentation PDF pp.9–26: p.11, argument #5, step 4 with clauses (a)–(b)
interpretation: No independent justification of collective exclusion is given here. This concerns the presentation’s collection and sufficient reason, not every actual concretum, all subsets, a well-founded borrowing graph or merely a ban on one act’s self-production. Being outside this collection is not spatial separation; reasons, causes and selected existential grounds remain distinct unless an independent application bridge is supplied.
